name: bett1
description: German online seller of mattresses, slatted bed frames, pillows, toppers, duvets and bed linen. Its shipping page lists shipping costs for mainland Germany and points to separate shops for Austria, Switzerland, the Netherlands, France, Poland and Spain.
description_es: Vendedor online alemán de colchones, bases de cama, almohadas, toppers, edredones y ropa de cama. Su página de envíos detalla costos para la Alemania continental y remite a tiendas separadas para Austria, Suiza, Países Bajos, Francia, Polonia y España.

ships_to.notes: Shipping table is labelled Germany excluding islands. Free from 49 EUR with standard or freight delivery, otherwise 5.90 EUR. Island delivery is not described.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Pickup of orders is not described. Only collection of returned mattresses is mentioned.

shopping_notes: Product pages in German. Delivery to other countries is stated as on request.

sources.supports: shipping rates for Germany excluding islands, other country shops
